suites.notes: All 24 named upstream cases ported across seven native fixtures and rebuilt/passed on one and four threads. Original meaningful assertions retained; typed errors/default selection, immutable hook updates and system field equality replace JS exceptions/omission/mutation/identity. Channel gates replace timing assumptions. This status covers this pinned test suite, not the higher-level Agent API, complete schema integration or providers. Supplemental wrapper/failure tests are tracked separately.

All 27 named upstream cases mapped across eight native fixtures; all pass together on one and four threads with exact upstream names checked once per run. Meaningful original assertions retained. Typed errors, immutable snapshots, explicit optional callbacks and channel/abort barriers replace JS exceptions, reference assertions and timer polling. Empty argument/detail fixture adapters use Unit where their values are not asserted; declaration schema structure is retained. This status covers the pinned Agent test suite, not full Agent API/configuration accessors, complete schema validation/inference, providers or package parity.

All six original named cases pass on one/four threads: strict/grammar capability conversion and fallback/rejection, unchanged tool declarations, unsafe-schema policies, grammar call/result replay, append-only grammar JSON deltas and streamed initial custom input. The public asynchronous processor receives the sample_tool-to-payload mapping; the retained start snapshot contains a, final sole tool call contains abc, concatenated emitted deltas parse to payload abc and final stop reason is toolUse. Native immutable schema builders, result values and event snapshots replace JS mutation while retaining all meaningful original assertions.

Both original named cases pass on one/four threads through normalizeContext and the public context estimator, including the exact buildBaseOptions maxTokens assertion. Supplemental source comparisons cover message/token accounting and base-option construction; native record encoders preserve application-specific parameter/argument types. Provider serialization/dispatch and transports remain pending.

306 actual-pi normalization/formatting comparisons pass on one/four native threads, including exact-name mapping of all 16 original scenarios at the typed transport-data boundary. Typed text/parsed/unavailable bodies replace SDK reflection and exclude streams/private state. Provider-specific status extraction, construction of body candidates from real failures, and catch-block integration remain pending; supplied status in these fixtures does not validate SDK field precedence.

All five original cases and assertions pass with one and four Bend runtime threads. Exact small integer inputs specialize the generic stream to U32; the explicit string-result case remains distinct. Four additional native lifecycle/shared-identity regressions supplement these cases. This suite does not establish full async-generator protocol, scheduler or AssistantMessageEventStream parity.

Two standalone named cases are ported with original model fields/assertions: ordinary reasoning models opt in to max, and a hole between high and max clamps upward. Catalog-backed cases and Codex provider payload cases remain pending. Supplemental direct-upstream helper tests cover 212 configurations and every typed requested level; model registry/provider parity is not claimed.

The named request-wide pricing-tier case is ported with its original model/usage inputs and all short/long charge assertions. Supplemental direct-upstream cost vectors cover 159 inputs and returned-object identity through shared cost references. Registry, provider publication, auth and other runtime cases remain pending.

Component evidence: 9,219 compatibility/cache comparisons, 168 environment comparisons, 914 field-assembly comparisons against buildParams with substituted converted inputs, and 192 full request-builder comparisons with actual transcript/message/tool converters pass on one/four native threads. The original suite remains pending because it invokes the complete provider with captured HTTP requests; explicit-header merging, public options/wrapper, hooks and transport integration remain unfinished.

The original public-converter case passes: the function-call output exists and equals (no tool output), excluding the attached-image fallback. Explicit fixture model identity/API replaces catalog lookup; registry/catalog behavior is not covered.

All original assertions pass through the public converter with the exact opaque Copilot ID: a function call exists, item ID equals fc_ plus shortHash of the source item component, is at most 64 units and matches the original alphanumeric shape. Explicit fixture model identity/API replaces catalog lookup; registry/catalog behavior is not covered.

All original assertions pass through normalizeContext and convertResponsesMessages: foreign thinking becomes a second visible text block, exact fallback IDs are msg_pi_1/msg_pi_1_1, and IDs are unique. Explicit fixture model identity/API replaces catalog lookup; registry/catalog behavior is not covered.

All five original named cases pass on one/four threads. The public processResponsesStream omits an absent terminal error and preserves namespaces arriving only at output_item.done for function/custom calls; normalizeContext and convertResponsesMessagesWith replay the exact call IDs, names, arguments/input and namespace. All three migrated targets drop namespaces; ordinary calls acquire none. Native Maybe values replace own-property assertions. Model identity/API and relevant fixture fields are explicit; model catalog behavior is not covered.

Ten of eleven original test instances pass through the public processResponsesStream on one/four threads: early EOF rejection, all three message-phase rows, terminal stop override, completed/incomplete usage and raw reasons, filtered/unknown incomplete errors and provider failure. Native immutable event snapshots and typed errors replace aliased mutable messages and thrown exceptions. The provider-wrapper early-EOF test remains pending; no request/HTTP/SSE/provider-wrapper parity is claimed. Exact source test names and phase rows are checked by tests/responses_terminal_named.py.

All nine named cases and original assertions pass on one and four runtime threads. Replay fixtures use the verified TypeBox 1.3.27 empty-object data shape. The executable declaration case uses a typed AgentTool and explicit Bend structural base projection, retaining the original true/false assertions and checking that callbacks are not invoked. Native direct-upstream declaration/state/history tests supplement this suite. Schema builders, Static<Parameters> relationships, validators, live-object semantics, custom-role adapters and full module integration remain pending; suite completion does not establish those contracts.

All four original named cases pass through the public native transformMessages on one/four threads: thinking-to-text migration, thought-signature removal, trailing orphan synthesis as the final message, and partial-result repair. Supplemental actual-source comparisons cover 87 composed transforms and callback traces, in addition to prior image/replay/repair stage checks. Normalizers are borrowed typed callbacks; failures become typed Result errors. This does not establish provider serialization/networking or untyped-session decoding parity.

Six original named cases are ported with 24 assertions: plain-JSON primitive coercion, nullable local-reference preservation, nullable oneOf preservation, nullable union coercion, nullable arrays (native compiled checker and public validation), and invalid primitive coercions. Supplemental tests compare 285 composed outcomes, 54 complete messages and 536 acyclic local-reference outcomes/exact messages with actual validateToolArguments, and exercise native formatted rejection through agent preparation/execution. Builder-specific conversion, recursive/external references, anchors, remaining schema vocabulary and the other named cases remain pending; this is not complete validation parity.
